title: Net of a cube with faces P to U (3 rows, 4 columns)
bodyMd: The table is the net of a cube drawn on a grid of equal squares. Each lettered cell is one square face of the cube; a blank cell is not part of the net. Two faces in cells that share a side are joined along that edge, and the net is folded along those edges to make the cube.

data.caption: Net of a cube. Lettered cells are faces; blank cells are not part of the net.

accessibilityText: The net of a cube laid out on a grid of three rows and four columns, with six lettered square faces and six blank cells that are not part of the net. Row 2, the middle row, is a strip of four faces in a line: Q in Column 1, R in Column 2, S in Column 3 and T in Column 4. Face P is in Row 1, directly above R, and is joined to R along R's top edge. Face U is in Row 3, directly below T, and is joined to T along T's bottom edge. All other cells are blank.

provenance.notes: Original net. Face letters run from P to U so that they cannot be confused with the answer labels. A folding script confirmed the opposite pairs P and U, Q and S, R and T.
